body:
I recently purchased some 3cb from an online research chemical supplier. The day I got it in the mail I opened it up and weighed out 10mg on a digital scale then snorted it strait off the scale not even 10 seconds later I was feeling it. The drip tasted like rust..
I started to feel the effects of the 3cb I felt like I just snorted 3 grams of yay and I was strait twacked out I looked in the mirror and my eyes were pinpoint I thought I was going to go blind.
I kept going up and up and up my heart was beating rapidly fast then it would stop for about a second then beat really slow then it would repeat that process over and over about 20 min later I couldn't open my mouth or stay in one spot then I just locked up and fell to the floor stayed into in this locked up fetal position for about 2 hours until my brother walked in my room and threw me in a cold shower.
I woke up in the hospital the next morning feeling like I got hit  by a truck. I strongly recommend you not to try this research chemical.
